attempts.cause: PRODUCT — the camera fit's 'planes/lines only' fallback (Box3 of the root group) ran BEFORE the whole-scene points were merged. At step 0 only vertices are drawn and their dot markers and pick spheres are excluded from the fit, so the fallback always fired and added two corners of a box padded by the pick radius. Every family's neutral figure sat 65-100 px left of the canvas centre and the orbit pivot sat ~0.9 units off the figure; under the W4 probe orbit (~92 deg azimuth, ~23 deg elevation) the flatter regular triangular pyramid's vertex C left the 683 px canvas by 17 px (the regular square pyramid kept 16 px). Diagnosed with a throwaway instrumented build (fit points dumped: 2 box corners, 0 drawn points); reverted, never committed.
attempts.user_decision: 2026-10-07 — move the orbit centre to the figure's centre (option chosen over 'record the limit' and 'shrink the initial frame'). The first proposal (slide the target along the view ray) was withdrawn after checking: the target was already the ray point closest to the box centre; the root cause was the fallback order.
attempts.fix: 1e90ca0e fix(scene3d): diemVuaKhung merges first and falls back to the box only when nothing finite remains (red baseline: the old order returned the two padded corners); refreeze 1bb11018

attempts.cause: ENVIRONMENT/HARNESS (intermittent) — the triangular_prism mobile page loaded WITHOUT its stylesheet: every style check of css_readiness false (scene not flex, canvas box static, controls and toolbar in the browser default font), screenshot blank, and the canvas grew to 374x10752 px. Without the stylesheet the canvas is displayed at its drawing-buffer size (2x on mobile), its auto-height box grows, the ResizeObserver resizes again — a runaway that also explains the 20-minute hang of the trial run. The fix in this run only changes which points the camera fit uses; it cannot change stylesheet application. Isolated reproduction on the same build: 0/8 (stylesheet 802 rules applied, canvas 517 px each time); the same build loaded the other mobile pages of attempt 2 normally (W04 8, W05 8, playback, suite 7).
attempts.product_fragility_noted: the runaway needs a missing stylesheet; recorded as a finding (renderer.setSize(w, h, false) leaves CSS sizing to the stylesheet), not fixed in this run
